_readme: The e.ventures site (eventures.vc, 2012-2021) as the firm's own portfolio wall, read through the logo files it uploaded (COLLECTION.md s5: a logo-only era is readable through the firm's own upload filenames). Team headshots are dropped; acquirer marks and filename variants are resolved per row; each capture_url is the citation (the capture itself was not re-fetched: machine-wide IA cooldown).
